title: terminal.toml
description:
How Banda's terminal writes: its font, size and ligatures, its echo
over a slow link, and its cursor. Every key is optional.

font.description:
The font: a font's name, or a CSS list of them. Left out, the
look's mono font.

size.description:
The text's size, in pixels. Left out, three quarters of the look's
text size.

ligatures.description:
Whether -> => != and the like are drawn as one sign, as the font
draws them.

echo.description:
Whether a letter typed over a slow link is drawn, underlined,
before its machine sends it back: "auto" or "off".

cursor.description: The cursor, until a program asks for another.

Echo.description:
Whether a letter typed over a slow link is drawn before its machine
sends it back.

oneOf.description: Only while the machine's answer takes long enough to feel.
Never: each letter shows as its machine sends it back.

CursorSettings.description: The cursor, until a program asks for another.

style.description: Its shape: the whole cell, a line before it, or a line under it.
